messages:
maria: Quick heads-up — I'm planning a quiet-window deploy for service-api v1.4.0 at 02:00 UTC. Putting together a short 'surgeon' rollback checklist so we all know who pulls which suture if things go sideways. Please read and ack or call dibs on ownership.

maria: Runbook excerpt (brief):
```
- Deploy rollout: staggered by region (NA->EU->APAC), 10% -> 50% -> 100% every 6m if no errors.
- Smoke checks: health /token endpoint, p99 latency on key routes, and sample-chat end-to-end.
- Rollback criteria: >3% error rate sustained over 5m OR p99 latency increase >150% OR any data-loss anomaly.
- Quick rollback steps:
  1) Abort rollout in console -> stop canary.
  2) Toggle ff/service_api_v1.4=false (feature-flags).
  3) If traffic still bad, promote last stable: pin model to v1.3.8 and restart pods via release-bot.
  4) If DB migration included: run migration-rollback job: `kubectl -n infra run rollback-mig -- image=infra-tools --command -- ./rollback-db v1.3.8`
- Kill-switch owners: network toggles = ops-oncall, feature-flag flip = kevin, release abort = aj.
```

maria: Key asks: can each owner confirm they can be on-call/available at 02:00-03:00 UTC? Also anyone who wants to run the smoke checks, please volunteer.

aj: I can be primary for the release abort and monitoring the canary windows. Will be on-call 01:45-03:15 UTC. :white_check_mark:

kevin: I'll own the ff flips and feature-flag rollbacks. Quick note — make sure FF has the fallback set to 'kill' not 'gradual', otherwise traffic won't fully re-route. I'll be available. :thumbsup:

release-bot: deploy v1.4.0 scheduled by maria at 1755555600 (planned). Canary window configured: 10%, 50%, 100% with 6m intervals.

sophie: I'll run the smoke test script and validate user-facing flows and sample requests. Sharing the script here: `scripts/smoke/service_api_smoke.sh` — will post results to this thread after each window.

ops-oncall: Network toggles and CDN purge are on my watch. If we need to kill cross-region traffic, I can flip the edge routing. Can be on for 02:00-03:30 UTC.

maria: Two small extras: 1) If you see error-rate spikes that are distributed across all routes, prefer abort+rollback. 2) If it's a single-route regression, we can consider targeted feature-gate for that route first.

kevin: Confirmed ff default updated to kill. Also added a short check: before flipping, I'll run `ffctl status service_api_v1.4` to confirm the feature flag health.

aj: Quick question — is there any DB migration included? The runbook shows rollback steps but I didn't see an actual migration in the PR.

maria: No DB migrations in this release — only binary changes and a small cache-key format bump that is backward-compatible. So step 4 in the runbook is precautionary.

kevin: Noted. Then rollback should be quick (FF flip + restart pinned pods). I'll queue the restart script once we decide.

sophie: I'll post smoke results after the 10% window at ~02:06 UTC. If anything looks off I'll tag `@aj @kevin @ops-oncall` and start the abort checklist.

maria: Everyone please react with :white_check_mark: once you can commit to the ownership window. If you can't, say who covers. Trying to keep this light but clear — surgeon checklist, not open-heart. :)

kevin: :white_check_mark:

aj: :white_check_mark:

ops-oncall: :white_check_mark: (have pager)

sophie: :white_check_mark: (will be in the channel)

maria: Great — thanks all. I'll kick at 02:00 UTC and post the live deploy steps. If you spot anything missing from the runbook above, shout now.

release-bot: deployment started by maria at 1755555600. Canary phase: 10% (NA).

sophie: 02:06 UTC — smoke on 10%: sample-chat OK, health OK, p99 latency within baseline. Posting logs: `logs/service-api/1755555605-canary.log`

maria: Nice. Advancing to 50% in 1min.

sophie: 02:12 UTC — smoke on 50%: small spike in POST /messages errors (0.9% -> 1.9%) but under 3% threshold. Monitoring.

aj: I'm watching metrics. No sustained rise on 5m window. Holding for 6m as planned.

kevin: No need to flip FF yet. Will stay on standby.

sophie: 02:19 UTC — 50% window stable, advancing to 100%. Final window kick-off.

release-bot: Canary phase complete. Traffic at 100% at 1755555699.

maria: Deploy finished, all owners stood by. Leaving this thread open for post-deploy regression check for next 30m. Thanks team! :tada:
